noKey: Without the key from the address this cannot be opened.
roleNoLink: “{name}” has not opened a link here — what they sent from the link will show once it is opened.
pickWho: Choose at the top of the page for whom.
chatShowsStrip: Heading and button — the conversation opens on click.

office.dataLater: The person’s data will appear once someone is chosen at the top of the page.
office.pick: Choose a person at the top of the page.
office.nothing: The person sees this part in their link — there is nothing to show about them here.

submission.label: Person’s submission
submission.use: Shows this person what they sent themselves in the chosen form.
submission.title: Your submission
submission.showsStrip: Heading and button — the submission opens on click.
submission.showsBlock: All the person’s chosen answers, with the option to correct them.
submission.missingForm: Choose the form the answers come from.
submission.missingShow: Choose which answers this person will see.
submission.empty: The submission of the person who opens their link will appear here.
submission.otherForm: This module shows a different form than the one the person at the top of the page was chosen from.

shared.label: Shared dates
shared.use: Dates the whole group sees — if the place carries its key.
shared.showsStrip: Heading and button — the dates open on click.
shared.showsBlock: The group’s dates for the coming weeks.
shared.empty: Shared dates will appear here if the place carries the group’s key.
shared.office: Here the person sees their group’s shared dates.

steps.label: Person’s steps
steps.use: The person’s list of steps — from the page’s logic map, and without steps on the map: the form’s steps (confirming data, additions, marks, tasks).
steps.title: Your steps
steps.empty: The list of steps of the person who opens their link will appear here.
steps.showsStrip: Heading and button — the steps open on click.
steps.showsBlock: The person’s list of steps, with what is already done.

tasks.label: Person’s tasks
tasks.use: Tasks for a period (e.g. the rosary in October) — the person answers for each day in the calendar.
tasks.title: Your tasks
tasks.noneNow: There are no tasks to do right now.
tasks.showsStrip: Heading, how many tasks are waiting, and a button — the tasks open on click.
tasks.showsBlock: The person’s current tasks: decision and days of doing them; finished ones folded below.
tasks.empty: The tasks of the person who opens their link will appear here.

chat.label: Group conversation
chat.use: Conversations of the person with a link: with the leaders, channels and conversations of the groups they belong to.
chat.showsTall: Conversation with a longer view of messages.
chat.showsBlock: Conversation: the latest messages and a field to write.
chat.empty: The group conversation will appear here — for the person who opens their link.

ask.label: Write to us
ask.use: The person with a link (from the chosen forms) starts a conversation with the chosen roles themselves — others from the form do not see it.
ask.says: heading; who answers and from which forms one may write is set in the module (not in the JSON)
ask.showsBlock: A “Write to: …” button, then this person’s conversation with the chosen roles.
ask.empty: Here the person who opens their link will write to the chosen people — only they and the person see this conversation.
